steps.title: Market Curves
steps.say: Let's look at how buyers and sellers interact. Buyers demand more at lower prices, while sellers supply more at higher prices.

steps.title: Finding Equilibrium
steps.say: Where the demand and supply curves cross, the market reaches equilibrium with a balanced price and quantity.

steps.title: Supply Decreases
steps.say: Suppose production becomes harder or more expensive. The supply curve shifts left because fewer goods are supplied at every price.

steps.title: The New Equilibrium
steps.say: Notice what happened: because supply fell, the equilibrium price rises while the equilibrium quantity falls.

steps.title: Explore the Market
steps.say: Now try dragging the curves yourself to see how different shifts in supply and demand affect the price and quantity.
